## Figure 2 

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
})
# =============================================================================
# SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURES: Additional Methods Analyses
# 4 panels covering key literature gaps
# =============================================================================
metrics_scores <- metrics_data_validation %>%
  group_by(cpg_grouping, model, organ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Rescale MAE (invert so that lower MAE → higher score)
    mae_score = scales::rescale(-mae),

    # Rescale R² to 0–1, where higher values → higher score
    r2_score = scales::rescale(r_squared_value)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # Composite continuous performance metric:
    # Higher values represent better-performing clocks
    performance_score = mae_score + r2_score,

    # Convert design factors to categorical variables
    cpg_grouping = factor(cpg_grouping),
    tile_methode = factor(tile_methode),
    model = factor(model),
    organ = factor(organ),
    rsq_threshold = factor(rsq_threshold),
    filter = factor(filter),

    # Scale numeric hyperparameters (important for mixed-model stability)
    epse_scaled = scale(epse)
  ) 

merged_metrics_scores <- metrics_scores%>%
  left_join(
    cpg_data_validation_long %>% 
      dplyr::select(unique_model_id, num_selected_cpg, num_candidate_cpg,selected_cpgs, chr,start,end),
    by = "unique_model_id"
  )

# =============================================================================
# FIGURE 4A: Multi-metric Comparison (MAE vs R² vs Performance Score)
# =============================================================================

p4a <- metrics_scores %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = r_squared_value, y = mae_score, colour = cpg_grouping)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, size = 0.8, colour ="black") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(x = expression(R^2), y = "Scaled Mean Average Error (MAE)", colour = "Method",
       title = "A. Correlation vs Error Trade-off") +
  theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom")

p4a_alt <- metrics_scores %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = performance_score, y = mae_score, colour = cpg_grouping)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se =T, size = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(x = "Performance Score", y = "Scaled Mean Average Error (MAE)", colour = "",
       title = "Performance vs Error") +
  theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom")

p4a + p4a_alt

# =============================================================================
# FIGURE 4B: Preprocessing Robustness (rsq_threshold sensitivity)
# =============================================================================
metrics_scores1 <- metrics_scores %>%
    mutate(
        rsq_thr_num = case_when(
            rsq_threshold == "r2_nofilter" ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ as.numeric(sub("r2_", "", as.character(rsq_threshold)))
        ),
        filter_num =  case_when(
            filter == "nofilter" ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ as.numeric(sub("min", "", as.character(filter)))
        )
    )

slopes_threshold <- merged_metrics_scores %>%
  mutate(sel_cpg = num_selected_cpg) %>%
  group_by(organ, rsq_threshold) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Also compute mean performance per threshold
  left_join(metrics_scores %>% 
              group_by(organ, rsq_threshold) %>%
              summarise(mean_perf = mean(performance_score), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("organ", "rsq_threshold"))

p4b <- ggplot(metrics_scores1, aes(x = rsq_thr_num, y = performance_score, colour = organ)) +
  geom_jitter( alpha = 0.2, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, size = 1) +
  labs(x = "R-Squared Threshold", y = "Performance Score",
       colour = "", title = "B. Filtering Threshold Sensitivity") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal)+
  theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )


# =============================================================================
# FIGURE 4C&D: Model Stability Across Organs (Rank Consistency)
# =============================================================================

# Compute model ranks per organ
model_ranks <- metrics_scores %>%
  group_by(organ) %>%
  mutate(rank_perf = rank(-performance_score)) %>%
  group_by( cpg_grouping,model,rsq_threshold, filter,epse ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rank = mean(rank_perf),
    rank_sd = sd(rank_perf),
    n_organs = n()
  )

p4c <- ggplot(model_ranks, aes(x = mean_rank, y = rank_sd, 
                              colour = cpg_grouping)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(model_ranks$mean_rank), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = median(model_ranks$rank_sd), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 4), name = "# Organs") +
  labs(x = "Mean Rank Across Organs", y = "Rank Variability",
       colour = "CpG Grouping", title = "C. Cross-Organ Stability") +
  theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, max(model_ranks$mean_rank, na.rm = TRUE)))

model_ranks1 <- metrics_scores %>%
  group_by(cpg_grouping) %>%
  mutate(rank_perf = rank(-performance_score)) %>%
  group_by( organ,model,rsq_threshold, filter,epse ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rank = mean(rank_perf),
    rank_sd = sd(rank_perf),
    n_organs = n()
  )

p4d <- ggplot(model_ranks1, aes(x = mean_rank, y = rank_sd, 
                              colour = organ)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(model_ranks1$mean_rank), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = median(model_ranks1$rank_sd), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 4), name = "# Organs") +
  labs(x = "Mean Rank Across CpG groups", y = "Rank Variability",
       colour = "Organ", title = "D. Cross-CpG grouping Stability") +
  theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, max(model_ranks$mean_rank, na.rm = TRUE)))
# =============================================================================
# COMBINED SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE 4
# =============================================================================

fig4 <- (p4a + theme(legend.position="none") |(p4b+guides(colour="none",fill="none")) ) / ((p4c ) | p4d) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") 

print(fig4)
ggsave("results/final_manuscript_figures/manuscript_complete_figure2.png", fig4, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 400)
```

### Statistical Analysis 
```{r}

# Panel A - Correlation vs Error Trade-off
# global correlation
cor_A_r2_mae <- cor.test(metrics_scores$r_squared_value,
                         metrics_scores$mae_score,
                         method = "pearson")

# per method (cpg_grouping)
slopes_A <- metrics_scores %>%
    group_by(cpg_grouping) %>%
    do({
        fit <- lm(mae_score ~ r_squared_value, data = .)
        broom::tidy(fit) %>% filter(term == "r_squared_value")
    })


# Panel B - Correlation vs Error Trade-off
slopes_B <- merged_metrics_scores %>%
    mutate(sel_cpg = num_selected_cpg) %>%
    group_by(organ) %>%
    do({
        dat <- .
        fit <- lmer(
            performance_score ~ sel_cpg + num_candidate_cpg +
                (1|selected_cpgs) + (1|chr),
            data = dat,
            REML = FALSE
        )
        broom.mixed::tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = FALSE)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(term == "sel_cpg") %>%
    mutate(
        p_value = 2 * pnorm(abs(statistic), lower.tail = FALSE)
    )

    
sum(slopes_B$p_value < 0.05)
# 

# Panel C - Filtering Sensitivity (R² threshold robustness)
slopes_C <- metrics_scores1 %>%
    group_by(organ) %>%
    do({
        dat <- .
        fit <- lmer(
            performance_score ~ rsq_thr_num  +
                (1|cpg_grouping) + (1|tile_methode)+ (1|model)+ (1|filter),
            data = dat,
            REML = FALSE
        )
        broom.mixed::tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = FALSE)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(term == "rsq_thr_num") %>%
    mutate(
        p_value = 2 * pnorm(abs(statistic), lower.tail = FALSE)
    )
delta_filter <- metrics_scores1 %>%
    group_by(organ) %>%
    summarise(delta = max(performance_score) - min(performance_score))

# Panel D - Cross-Organ Stability (Rank variability)

# Compute model ranks per organ
model_ranks <- metrics_scores %>%
  group_by(organ) %>%
  mutate(rank_perf = rank(-performance_score)) %>%
  group_by( cpg_grouping,model,rsq_threshold, filter,epse ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rank = mean(rank_perf),
    rank_sd = sd(rank_perf),
    n_organs = n()
  )

# Panel D - Cross-Organ Stability (Rank variability)
med_mean <- median(model_ranks$mean_rank, na.rm = TRUE)
med_sd   <- median(model_ranks$rank_sd, na.rm = TRUE)

model_ranks_summary <- model_ranks %>%
  mutate(
    stability_class = case_when(
      mean_rank < med_mean & rank_sd < med_sd ~ "High-performing stable",
      mean_rank < med_mean & rank_sd >= med_sd ~ "High-performing unstable",
      mean_rank >= med_mean & rank_sd < med_sd ~ "Low-performing stable",
      TRUE ~ "Low-performing unstable"
    )
  )

table(model_ranks_summary$stability_class)

# Summarise counts of stability classes by method


method_summary_percent <- method_summary %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total = sum(c_across(`High-performing stable`:`Low-performing unstable`))) %>%
  mutate(across(`High-performing stable`:`Low-performing unstable`, ~ . / total * 100))
method_summary_percent

#####
# Compute model ranks per cpg grouping
model_ranks <- metrics_scores %>%
  group_by(cpg_grouping) %>%
  mutate(rank_perf = rank(-performance_score)) %>%
  group_by( organ,model,rsq_threshold, filter,epse ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rank = mean(rank_perf),
    rank_sd = sd(rank_perf),
    n_organs = n()
  )

# Panel D - Cross-Organ Stability (Rank variability)
med_mean <- median(model_ranks$mean_rank, na.rm = TRUE)
med_sd   <- median(model_ranks$rank_sd, na.rm = TRUE)

model_ranks_summary <- model_ranks %>%
  mutate(
    stability_class = case_when(
      mean_rank < med_mean & rank_sd < med_sd ~ "High-performing stable",
      mean_rank < med_mean & rank_sd >= med_sd ~ "High-performing unstable",
      mean_rank >= med_mean & rank_sd < med_sd ~ "Low-performing stable",
      TRUE ~ "Low-performing unstable"
    )
  )

table(model_ranks_summary$stability_class)

# Summarise counts of stability classes by method
method_summary <- model_ranks_summary %>%
  group_by(organ, stability_class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = stability_class, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

method_summary

method_summary_percent <-method_summary %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total = sum(c_across(`High-performing stable`:`Low-performing unstable`))) %>%
  mutate(across(`High-performing stable`:`Low-performing unstable`, ~ . / total * 100))
method_summary_percent
```

## Figure 3
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# FIGURE 3: Uncertainty vs Complexity (epse analysis)
# =============================================================================

p3a <- ggplot(merged_metrics_scores, aes(x = num_selected_cpg, y = epse_scaled, 
                                 colour = cpg_grouping)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(x = "Selected CpGs (log10)", y = "Scaled Tile size",
       colour = "Method", title = "A. Uncertainty vs CpG Count") +
  theme_classic2(base_size = 14) 

p3b <- ggplot(metrics_scores, aes(x = performance_score, y = epse_scaled, 
                                 colour = model)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(x = "Performance Score", y = "Scaled ETile size",
       colour = "Model", title = "B. Uncertainty vs Accuracy") +
  theme_classic2(base_size = 14) 

fig3 <- p3a | p3b 
print(fig3)
ggsave("results/final_manuscript_figures/manuscript_complete_figure3.png", fig3, width = 8.5, height = 6, dpi = 400)

```
